summary: Kingsoft Cloud Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K on September 21, 2026, furnishing its 2026 Interim Report as Exhibit 99.1, signed by CFO Yi Li. The filing is a routine foreign-private-issuer interim results disclosure under the 1934 Act, not a special situation. No transaction terms, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation are stated. The document is a standard periodic update for a Beijing-based prepackaged software company listed on the NYSE. No deal mechanics, regulatory clock, or risk-arb angle apply; watch for ordinary operating and liquidity disclosures within the interim report.
